notes.title: 69 Hours Remain...
notes.notes: [p]69 Hours Remain in the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Winter Heat Kickstarter campaign[/url]![/p][p]It's your last best chance to support Yuri Kissaten's game developer dreams, and be greatly rewarded with an awesome yuri romance game that takes place through chatrooms, video calls, and social media apps! (There's also a full RPG Roguelike sub-game included because we're silly) [/p][p]Through this Kickstarter, you can get your own OC included in the game as an NPC, you can get an in-universe brochure, and you can even get your very own Oomfie plushie mailed directly to you. All that, AND you'll help ensure that Yuri Kissaten stays afloat long enough to release some truly banger games in 2026, such as [i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503300/Toxic_Yuri/"]Toxic Yuri[/url][/i] and the [i][url="https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/28970/hands-held-in-the-snow"]Hands Held in the Snow[/url][/i] game adaptation. [/p][p][i]Winter Heat[/i] releases in November, so you won't have to wait long for the release, but this campaign will help us turn a pretty good small game into something much stronger, much cuter, and I'm so thankful for all the support we've received so far.[/p][p]Also, don't forget to play the free demo![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: Gallery App Added
notes.notes: [p]The new demo update adds another app - the Gallery![/p][p][/p][p]Most visual novels have an image galley of some sort, but with [i]Winter Heat[/i]'s app system, you can expand the story and learn more about the lives of Javi and Shio through the Gallery. Not only will you unlock beautiful art from the main game by director and lead artist [url="https://fruz.quest"]Fruz[/url], but you'll get more art and photographs of daily life in Chile and Japan, divided up by different folders across time and topic. Discover an even richer story through the Gallery in the full game. And now it's in the demo, too, mainly to demonstrate what's coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p]The next demo update will hopefully include a sizeable update to the Oomfie RPG sub-game, as well as the Maps app. We're trying to get the demo as far along as possible before the end of the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Kickstarter campaign[/url], which still has about two weeks remaining. We're shooting for some cool stretch goals, so please support by pledging or sharing![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: New App - Test Your English!
notes.notes: [p]As part of our weekly content updates throughout the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Winter Heat Kickstarter campaign[/url], we've added a new app to the demo experience-- Test Your English![/p][p]It's only a couple minutes long, to demonstrate the type of gameplay you can look forward to in the full release. This is the app that Shio uses every day to train up her English level so she can communicate more effectively with people from around the world. How will YOU do?[/p][p]Give us your feedback on this app and especially ideas for extremely silly English language questions. Just yesterday, we reached our stretch goal to expand this app into an even bigger experience, so please look forward to that![/p][p][/p][p]There are a few other smaller updates to the demo, but mostly under the hood so the game doesn't break later down the line. [/p][p][/p][p]See you next week![/p]

notes.title: COMING AUGUST 1ST: Winter Heat Kickstarter Campaign!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][b]Coming to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Kickstarter[/url] on August 1st![/b][/p][p][i][b]Winter Heat[/b][/i] [b]is more than a love story. It’s the texts, notes, games, and digital worlds of a couple across years of their lives.[/b] This wholesome visual novel chronicles a modern romance in a uniquely digital way.[/p][p]Javiera Vera is a freelancer living in the sweltering summer of Maipú, Santiago, in Chile. Fukkoshi Shio is an office worker living in the snowy rural town of Miyazu, Kyoto, in Japan. Though they live on different sides of the world, they share something that transcends all boundaries: an internet connection.[/p][p][b]How will their friendship deepen during one special December? Find out through the apps Javi and Shio use every day.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/40a688196b5171ee99c19b133b0dc2b4d1a19fd5.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re raising finishing funds for [i]Winter Heat[/i] to help expand the game further and further. Not only will we have an extensive main story, but we’ll also have a boatload of in-story “apps.” Some are educational, some flesh out the characters, some are even full-fledged minigames.[/p][p]More Kickstarter backers means more in-universe apps to explore and even more content for the main storyline. Back the campaign to follow our progress…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/448bc3081e5ff27008ac69bda0ebf30205f2b732.png"][/img][/p][p]…and let Javi and Shio’s story unfold.[/p][h3][b]Digital Love with Digital Apps[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/42bc29eedbee022c4951d3cb60f6fc08e024c951.png"][/img][/p][p]Enjoy the classic late 00s browser-based kid-friendly MMO [b]Froguelike[/b] in special flashback chapters \[Game not actually playable]! See how Javi and Shio first met as young teens, and how they reunited after many years apart.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/4c6ed99f28686afbfb8870c0d16e0da6792e83dd.png"][/img][/p][p]Learn more about Javi and Shio’s towns through the [b]Maps[/b] app. Find out the best spots in Kyoto and Santiago, the local haunts, and plan your inevitable Yuri Tourism trip.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/a24a24d98d1d2ecc5b513d507433f0f4dbd9e14d.png"][/img][/p][p]With the [b]Wittier[/b] app, find Javi and Shio online—along with trolls and other weird strangers. Then smash keywords together to post engagement bait. Can you rack up 10,000 followers?[/p][p]We’re working on many more apps as well, and with your crowdfunding support, we can make them better and better. And, with stretch goals, we’ll even add brand-new apps![/p][h3][i][b]Welcome to Oomfie RPG[/b][/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/786ea3c062d97f2f4521a0f8dd77394ab1b93c3c.gif"][/img][/p][p]But of course, our most important app is a full-fledged sub-game: [b]Oomfie RPG![/b][/p][p]Each copy of [i]Winter Heat[/i] comes with a ROM of one of Javi and Shio’s favorite nostalgic games (and pieces of riffing material): [i]Oomfie World IV: The 1994 Saga of Turbo[/i]. Why does the title include “1994”? We’re not sure. Probably because that sounded futuristic in 1993.[/p][p]After her best friend Sam is sucked into the hot new game console, Oomfie must traverse the digital world of Turbo and collect pieces of the Virtual Cuboid Console to send them both back.[/p][p]Discover a comfy town and four mazelike adventure zones, switching from a classic overhead view to first-person face-offs in the Chili Forest and other whimsical locales.[/p][p][b]Every run through an adventure zone is different, with its own special events.[/b] Meet friends and not-so-friends on the road, and decide whether to trade, help, or run away really fast. The further you go, the more forks in the road.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/435287335654a7682c77d2c7d89e660281e654b9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Then oomf your way through tricky turn-based batles.[/b] Use Action Points to attack, but watch out: your AP is also your health! Healing at the right moments and reading your opponents’ moves are the keys to victory.[/p][p]You have space for eight moves…and items. Together. Will you pick up a weapon, or a healing hamburger? [b]Make tough choices on the road,[/b] and pray that the merchant has a good selection.[/p][p]Only your customized Oomfie can beat all four adventure zones and save the day![/p][h3][b]And You’ve Gotta Help![/b][/h3][p]Oomfie is counting on you to support [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]our Kickstarter when it launches on [b]August 1st[/b][/url]! We’ll also be launching a [b]brand-new demo[/b] on Steam and Itch so you can try out the new apps and the Oomfie RPG.[/p][p]We’re overjoyed to show the world this game that’s so close to our hearts.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Kickstarter link: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Steam link: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Itch link: [/p][p][url="https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat"]https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Press kit: [/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/"]https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Visit our site: [/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com"]https://yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow on Bluesky: [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Subscribe on Youtube: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yurikissaten"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Support on Patreon: [/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten"]https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan - Our New Game (It's Free)
notes.notes: [p]Please check out [i]Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan[/i], Yuri Kissaten new FREE game. It's a short but powerful experience about important real-life issues in modern-day Japan, so please set aside 30 or 40 minutes to play it.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554600/Life_of_a_Dispatch_English_Teacher_in_Japan/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can learn more about the game by visiting its [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fyurikissaten.com%2Flife-of-a-dispatch-english-teacher-in-japan-press-kit%2F"]press kit page[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]It may be an emotionally heavy game, but Yuri Kissaten also has plenty of much lighter, much cuter projects coming up in the extremely near future--stay tuned for those. notes.title: Happy Yuri Day! + Kickstarter Pre-Launch Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Today is International Yuri Day across the internet. Go celebrate lesbian fiction in whatever ways you can. For Yuri Kissaten, we're celebrating by announcing a big upcoming event:[/p][p][i]Winter Heat[/i] will be released in November, but we've been expanding the scope of the game lately, and we'll be announcing a lot more about that in the near future. But first, please prepare for an awesome [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel/"]Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439963/ffe54900d1369d4d802d90c544866c03c406bdef.png"][/img][/p][p]It'll be pretty small, just "finishing funds" to polish the game and add bonus features--it'll help make the game even stronger. We don't have a precise start date yet, but we'll sure let you know when it's set.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, make sure to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel/"]follow the campaign[/url] to get notified about it, and tell as many friends as you can! You can also get early access to the upcoming demo and get exclusive behind-the-scenes updates on [url="https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten/"]our Patreon[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Happy Yuri Day everyone![/p]
